text: __NOTOC__ Skreah is an arakkoa alchemy vendor located in the Lower City of Shattrath City.
Skethyl Owls are undead kaliri found flying around Sketh'lon in Shadowmoon Valley.
Skettis Outcasts are arakkoa located in the Lower City in Shattrath City.
Skittering Hollow is an Island Expedition in Battle for Azeroth. It's a dark, rocky island inhabited by troggs, kobold and nerubians. Mogu and forest trolls can also be found here.
Skithis the Infused is a sethrak found siphoning power from a large :Azerite crystal in the Blistering Wastes in Vol'dun while the world quest Azerite Empowerment (Skithis the Infused) is available.
Skybreaker Whip is a trinket quest reward from the Netherwing quest Dragonmaw Race: Captain Skyshatter. The quest requires Honored Netherwing and Epic flying.

Skyguard Handler Deesak is a human quest giver located at Blackwind Landing in Terokkar Forest. Upon achieving honored reputation with the Sha'tari Skyguard, he serves as a free-of-charge flight path between Blackwind Landing and Skyguard Outpost in the Blade's Edge Mountains, just outside Ogri'la. His counterpart in Blade's Edge is Skyguard Handler Irena.

Skumblade Saur-Priests are Saurok mobs on the Isle of Thunder. Their Flurry of Teeth and Devouring Plague abilities are strong and should be interrupted. When spoken to with the Skin of the Saurok buff, they reveal the religious beliefs of the Skumblade Saurok: instead of being created by Mogu Flesh-shaping, they teach the saurok that they are the descendants of a powerful Devilsaur spirit named Kros. Despite their history being wrong, the Echo of Kros is real.
Skyhorn is a Highmountain tauren village found in eastern Highmountain. As the name suggests, it is the home of the Skyhorn tribe. It is currently under attack by the Crawliac harpies.
Skyhorn Boxers are Highmountain tauren boxers and members of the Skyhorn tribe found training and competing under the supervision of Trainer Kod in a cave south of Skyhorn in Highmountain.

__NOTOC__ Skycaller Faeb is a night elf druid located at Aviana's shrine in the northern edge of Dreamgrove, and at Nighthaven in Moonglade. Druids who have completed You Can't Take the Sky from Me can speak to her at either location to switch between Archdruid's Lunarwing Form and Flight Form.
Skyhorn Interceptors are Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain, during Legion Assaults, and on the Broken Shore.
Skyhorn Pathfinders are Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain.
Skyhorn Prisoners are Highmountain tauren held in Legion Cages in Feltotem in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.
Skyhorn Survivalists are Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain. They also appear during the Legion Assaults.

Skycallers' Spire is a massive structure nestled among the mountains of northern Vol'dun that serves as one of the main strongholds of the Faithless sethrak and hosts the entrance to the subterranean Temple of Sethraliss. Without flying, the spire can only be accessed from the south by climbing a huge stair from the Thundering Terrace, which can in turn only be reached by traversing a large bridge spanning the ravine known as the Slithering Gulch. The spire area itself consists of a vast, crystal-littered plaza where numerous Faithless congregate. This plaza extends into a separate eastern area roamed by sethrak skycallers, while heading west leads to an area known the Sacred Sands. Above ev

__NOTOC__ Skywing is a quest giver located on the eastern edge of the Bone Wastes of Terokkar Forest. He is an arakkoa cursed into the form of a parrot by Luanga the Imprisoner. The magical energies released during Skywing's transformation back into his true arakkoa form liberated Miniwing, a fledgling bird imprisoned by Luanga in order to power his fowl curse.

The gronn Slaag is one of the seven sons of Gruul the Dragonkiller. He exiled himself from the Blade's Edge Mountains and took control of the Gordunni ogres that reside in the Barrier Hills just outside of Shattrath City. He is one of the three Gronn who Mog'dorg the Wizened asks the player to kill.

Skytalons are a type of owl-like emerald bird associated with the green dragonflight and the Emerald Dream. When Ysera was asked by Nishera the Garden Keeper to aid in the fight against the Scourge in Dragonblight, she misunderstood, instead telling the defenders of the Emerald Dragonshrine, including skytalons, to treat those not of the green dragonflight as enemies. The Emerald Dragonshrine skytalons are led by Alystros the Verdant Keeper, an immense skytalon who is the one in charge of the Dragonshrine's aerial defenses. It appears that skytalons are reborn shortly after being killed. Jade is naturally rich with life and color, making it the perfect raw material for the gentle jade owl. I
Skyshattered is an achievement gained by completing Dragonmaw Race: Captain Skyshatter

Slain Forsaken are Forsaken located in Gilneas City during the Fangs of the Father questline. They surround the area near Lord Hiram Creed, and are mentioned by Zazzo Twinklefingers to have failed in rooting him and his soldiers out of the city.

The Necrolyte clan believes that the strange slimes found in certain areas seek to eat the blood of the Orcs. No magiks could have created these crawling masses, but yet they exist. This slime seems attracted to the heat of Orcish bodies, and will seep through even the tightest armor to drain into the pores of its victims skin and sap them of strength and life. Not all of the putrid, slick goo that oozes from openings in the floors and walls is merely disgusting. Some of it poses great danger as well. While slime has no intelligence, it is attracted to the heat that bodies generate. This ichor will literally drain the life from its victims, as heat is what it uses as food. No magical propert
Slidfen is a jungle troll located in the Court of the Sun of Silvermoon City. He stands next to and , seen talking with both of them.

Slinky Sharpshiv is a goblin rogue trainer first found on the isle of Kezan, then in the Lost Isles, and finally ends up in Azshara like most of the Bilgewater Cartel goblins. In Azshara she is replaced as trainer by her brother, Stinky, as she is in Talrendis Point on a mission to assassinate Captain Grunwald. She also appears in the Deadmines to bring Helix Gearbreaker, traitor to the Bligewater Cartel, the Shattered Hand and the Horde to justice, noting that she herself had not been invited to the Shattered Hand yet. Slinky also helps defend Sethria's Roost on Mount Hyjal against the minions of Ragnaros during the quest The Protectors of Hyjal.

Sludgewerks Enforcers are goblins that guard the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains. They are only found in the area immediately surrounding the flight master and Jibbly Rakit. The level 35 version is there normally, while the level 85 version appears when Alliance approach the area. The Enforcers do not enjoy their work guarding the Sludgewerks, and the job has a high turnover rate. While on guard, they will sometimes say one of the following: : : : : : : : : Enforcers will often go to Jibbly and say one of the following lines, then run out of the camp: : : : : : : :

in the TCG.]] :Were you looking for Blacksmithing? Smith is usually an abbreviation for "blacksmith", but can refer to many different types of metal-crafting trades. Most smithing vendors should have the ability to repair. Blacksmiths utilize their expertise with hammer and anvil to craft deadly weapons, heavy suits of mail and plate armor, and other, more specialized items. Talented blacksmiths can also modify their own equipment by adding sockets for magical gems. The gear that they make allows them to outfit themselves, equip party members or guildmates, and sell their craftsmanship via the auction house.
__NOTOC__ Small Obsidian Shards are pieces of dark volcanic rock that can be used by Blacksmiths to craft strong armors with anti-magical powers.
Smoldering Embers drop from the following fire elementals in Stonetalon Mountains: *Burning Ravager *Rogue Flame Spirit *Burning Destroyer
Smoking Shard of Teleportation is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Small Corpsefly Egg drops from Fleshwing in Korthia for Necrolord Covenant players. It will turn into Hatching Corpsefly Egg which hatches into a Lord of the Corpseflies.

Smith Gaan is a centaur located in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He is one of the few surviving members of Clan Toghus, having been rescued from the village of Daruukhan after it was destroyed by Clan Nokhud. After he is rescued by Taivan and the player returns to Marukaai, he and the rest of the Toghus survivors can be found near the center of the city, being tended to for their injuries.

Sneaky Pete is a Forsaken located in Dazar'alor. As a member of Greenbelly's Raiders, he can also appear on the Horde team during Island Expeditions. Pete also appears on Mechagon Island, in search of treasure.

.]] Snooters are a race of mammals found on Mechagon Island. They have a very good sense of smell and can easily find grass and seeds buried under snow or scrap. Some have adapted dark fur to hide under junkheaps across the island. King Mechagon owns a rare type of snooter known as the Golden Snorf. It is so abnormal and rare that, despite his crusade on all things flesh, he could not bring himself to mechanize the rare type of creature.
Snarling Butterfly Crate has a chance to drop from Honey Smasher in Stormsong Valley. In summons a Crimson Skipper butterfly.

Socrethar's Seat is the throne of the eredar Socrethar, and his demonic minions. The seat occupies an entire floating island, the far northwestern of the larger ones in Netherstorm. It can either be accessed via a Flying Mount or a quest portal generator which is obtained during either Deathblow to the Legion (Aldor Quest version) or Turning Point (Scryer Quest version). Socrethar's Seat is known for a location to farm Mark of Sargeras. Inhabitants: * Socrethar * Kaylaan the Lost * Hatecryers * Wrath Lords
The Snowy Gryphon can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Hellfire Peninsula * in Shadowmoon Valley * in Borean Tundra * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City

{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Sobi Mask |icon=BTNSobiMask |desc=Increases the Hero's rate of mana regeneration by 50% when worn. |sell=200 }} Increases the Hero's rate of mana regeneration by 50% when worn.
Snow Tracker Grumm is a taunka located in the Borean Tundra. He is laying in the ground in the Temple City of En'kilah. He lives just long enough to ask the player to help by destroying the orbs.

Snowstorm the hippogryph is a 'mount' loaned to the player character from Palena Silvercloud upon accepting the Stars' Rest version of High Commander Halford Wyrmbane (quest). Snowstorm is only a part of the tour started by accepting the quest. The character has no influence upon the hippogryph, and is automatically carried from Stars' Rest to Wintergarde Keep.

Socrethar the Eternal is a boss in the Amphitheater of the Eternal in the in Tanaan Jungle. Following his death in during the Garrison Campaign, his soul was taken by his Sargerei and placed into a fel-tainted vigilant construct so he could become immortal. The battle with Socrethar the Eternal is one of the easier fights in the upper wing of Hellfire Citadel. So long as the tank who pilots the construct in phase 2 understands his abilities, the fight is quite simple.

Snowblind Mesa is a valley found just east of Thunder Totem before reaching the Snowblind Cliffs in Highmountain. From here adventurers can either travel east into Stormheim, south into the Greystone mountains, or visit the Snowmane Village on the southeastern side.
Snowblossom Village (or just Snowblossom) is an Island Expedition and home to a pandaren town attacked by virmen and undead. The island is also inhabited by mantid and mogu.
Social Butterfly is a soulbind trait granted by Dreamweaver. It is exclusive with Soothing Voice and Empowered Chrysalis.

__NOTOC__ Somnus is an elite green drake found in the Swamp of Sorrows. He is an ancient champion of the green dragonflight. Presumably, Somnus is associated somehow with the Green Flight's purpose within the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. He was one of the four drakes that had to be killed for the Horde side of the Onyxia-key quest chain. Emberstrife wanted Somnus' skull. Apparently, he caused problems to lower-level players who were trying to quest in the area.
Soldier of the Battle for Gilneas City is a passive buff rewarded from the quest The Battle for Gilneas City. This buff works only during this quests, improving morale and restoring 73-74 health.

Sonic Focus is a pet ability available exclusively to the bat family of hunter pets, increasing player multistrike chance by 5%. It is functionally identical to the core hound family's Double Bite, the wind serpent family's Breath of the Winds, and the dragonhawk family's Spry Attacks, but surpassed in effectiveness by the Wild Strength of the clefthoof family, which provides additional Versatility.
Solar Wrath is a level 1 Balance and Restoration druid ability. The effect of the ability depends on the specialization.
Solar Emanator is an Amathet device located at the Chamber of the Stars within the Obelisk of the Stars in Uldum.

.]] The soul (aka spirit or life essence) is the very personification of an individual. In living beings, the soul is anchored to the body by the cosmic force of Life. When a being is resurrected as an undead with necromancy, through the use of Death magic, their soul is imperfectly attached to their body through the same Death magic. When a being dies, their soul crosses the veil between life and death and enters Oribos in the Shadowlands, where they are judged by the Arbiter and sent off to one of the realms of the Shadowlands based on their actions in life. Every living soul brings with it a vital force known as anima.
__NOTOC__ Sorim Lightsong was a blood elf quest giver located outside the tailoring guild in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

.]] The Sorcerers' League was one of three factions within Dalaran, including the Kirin Tor and Mages' Guild, which tried to hold back the forces of the Scourge during Arthas' siege of the city during the Third War. These three factions were also the ones trying to prevent Kel'Thuzad from summoning Archimonde outside Dalaran (or simply trying to destroy the Scourge, unaware of the summoning). In Reforgeds Under the Burning Sky, the Sorcerers' League was replaced by Alliance Defenders, indicating that Dalaran didn't fight alone against the invasion.

Sorrow Wing Point is an "island" south of the Bone Wastes and only reachable by a flying mount. A purple tameable tallstrider called Lost Torranche can be found here. The quest called The Hawk's Essence also occurs here.
Soul Harvest is a passive warlock ability that regenerates 2% of maximum health every second while out of combat, but only outside arenas.

Soothsayer's Runes is a Darkmoon Faire artifact. It rarely drops from selected level-appropriate raid bosses for players with a Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide in their inventory. It begins the quest Tools of Divination.

Soothing Shade is a soulbind trait available on row 1 of Theotar the Mad Duke's soulbind tree. It gives your abilities a chance to summon Tubbins and Gubbins, who temporarily provide a shaded area that increases your mastery while you stand in it. This ability has an internal cooldown of 20 seconds.
Soothing Voice is a soulbind trait granted by Dreamweaver. It is exclusive with Social Butterfly and Empowered Chrysalis.

Soul Shards are a unique secondary resource available to warlocks, displayed in the user interface beneath the player's health and mana bars. Warlocks can have a maximum of five Soul Shards, which slowly regenerate out of combat and regenerate in combat through certain spells. Soul Shards have been around in some form since early WoW and have a long history as a secondary resource for warlocks in general.
Soulburn: Demonic Circle: Teleport is a passive Affliction warlock ability, available at level 86.

Soulkeeper Uriah is a blood elf warlock and the mentor of Apprentice Rosalyn, found in the westernmost part of Mucksnout Den in Highmountain. He and Rosalyn were were to transport a handful of Soul Chambers to Allari the Souleater in Azsuna, but while traveling through Mucksnout Den their caravan was attacked by a group of Mucksnout kobolds that stole the shards. Uriah insisted on going further into the cave to retrieve the chambers, leaving Rosalyn at the entrance, where she asks adventurers for aid in finding her mentor. By the time the adventurer finds Uriah, he is heavily injured and only manages to briefly talk with Rosalyn before dying, leaving his apprentice and the adventurer to deta
Soulsnatcher is a Destruction warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Chaotic Instability and Demonic Durability traits.

The Soulfused Construct, later known as Unity, is an extremely powerful abomination made entirely of kyrian flesh, created by First Apprentice Malkrex and Sharrex the Fleshcrafter in the Flesh Stitchery in Maldraxxus. The construct is the culmination of Surgeon Stitchflesh's research and was intended to serve as the ultimate creation of the House of Constructs, but Malkrex slightly botched the procedure by failing to purge the flesh of its memories before assembling it. As a result, kyrian souls still exist within the construct. Secutor Mevix initially wants to destroy the abomination after he and the Maw Walker slay Sharrex and Malkrex, but Aspirant Thales intervenes as he can sense the sou

Soul Rot is the warlock class ability of the Night Fae Covenant. It's available to all warlocks who join the Night Fae. This ability is also temporarily available during the Ardenweald portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Preparing for the Winter Queen and lasts until you finish the Ardenweald storyline.

.]] The South Seas, also known as the South Sea, is a body of water that surrounds the southern regions of the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor, and the northern coasts of Pandaria. Notable islands like Zandalar, Kezan or Tel'Abim are located here. Since this sea is found in between the continents, it is a portion of the Great Sea.

Southwind Village was once a night elven base of operation in Silithus, but was destroyed by the qiraji during the War of the Shifting Sands. Following the devastation of Silithus by Sargeras, its ruins now serve as a Horde base for the goblin mining operation for :Azerite in the Wound.

The region of Southern Kalimdor (aka southern Kalimdor or South Kalimdor) is the southernmost region or continent of Kalimdor, south of central Kalimdor. Southern Kalimdor is by far the wildest area of the continent of Kalimdor. Much of its lands are uncharted, and there are few settlements larger than small towns. Ancient ruins dating back to the Great Sundering — and earlier — dot the landscape. The terrain varies from thick forests and jungles to vast desert wastelands or bleak salt flats. The creatures that dwell there are vicious and deadly. One should not venture forth into the south without plenty of supplies and good, strong weapons at his side. There are six major zones in southern

South Gate Pass connects Dun Morogh in the high mountains to the west with Loch Modan in the lower mountains to the east. It is frequently traveled by adventurers coming from or going to Thelsamar, as this pass is the closest to the dwarven town. South Gate Pass is also the location of the guard station of South Gate Outpost. South Gate Pass.jpg|The pass entrance, Dun Morogh side. South Gate Pass2.jpg|The pass entrance, Loch Modan side.

The Southmoon Ruins is an area of ancient troll ruins in southern Tanaris, just north of the Valley of the Watchers. Ancient tablets were discovered here, believed to contain Titan knowledge. The Reliquary and Explorers' League now fight for control the tablets within. Directly south of here is the Explorer's League camp, known as Gunstan's Dig according to flight paths. Prospector Gunstan leads the group from here.
The Southfury Moonstone sit on top of the Moonstone Altar in Azshara.

Sparks are a type of lightning or arcane elemental creature that appears in certain places where magic is prevalent. They tend to have a specific purpose, such as healing or buffing a boss, exploding, or summoning adds. It is unknown if they are sentient or just an advanced form of spell that is cast by powerful arcane beings. Sparks should not be confused with wisps, which are ethereal nature spirits that have a superficial resemblance to sparks.

__NOTOC__ The Spark of Imagination is a subzone of Ulduar. Mimiron resides within here. During the third invasion, the Huntmaster of the Unseen Path and Grif Wildheart were teleported to Mimiron's workshop during their search for Titanstrike after Prustaga betrayed them. As the two hunters were assisting Mimiron with obtaining information on Prustaga's location from XR9-47, the chamber overclocked, so they also helped stabilize it. During the Fourth War, the hunter adventurer and Grif returned here. Mimiron used the Thunderspark's power to reform Hati's body.

:Sad about the Cataclysm? Not after one of these. The pineapple puts a joyful new spin on an old classic. South Island Iced Tea is created with Cooking (525); taught by Recipe: South Island Iced Tea. It can also be drunk freely at the Salty Sailor Tavern during the Kirin Tor Tavern Crawl.
The South Pavilion is the southeastern pavilion found in the Darkmoon Faire. It hosts the Darkmoon Faire Dance organized by Simon Sezdans.
Spark-7143 is provided by Flip Quickcharge for Real Ultimate Power to summon Animated Sludges in the the Outflow on Mechagon Island.

{{Infobox anima power | name = Spaceweaver's Thread | icon = inv_misc_thread_01 | description = Blink's cooldown reduced by ${-3000/-1000} | class = Mage | quality = Common | affects = Blink, Shimmer }} Spaceweaver's Thread is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

__NOTOC__ The Sparkling Animaseed is found in Mistveil Tangle when the area is empowered through the use of the Anima Conductor in the Heart of the Forest. It can be thrown at Valfir the Unrelenting in order to dispell its protective magic.
The Specter is a unique Ghost Creep that appears in A New Power in Lordaeron surrounded by Ghosts and Wraiths that guards a Lordaeron City Stash.

Spiders are a type of animal found commonly throughout Azeroth and Draenor, and even other planes of existence such as the Firelands and the Shadowlands. The most common of the arachnid family, these critters spin their webs in nearly every corner of Azeroth. Commonly enhanced by corruptive magic, like the fel magic of the Burning Legion, or the necromancy of the Scourge or the Forsaken, they are also seen as plain wild animals. Spiders can be expected to use poisonous attacks and webbing in combat, often from a distance. One species of spider has entirely lost their carnivorous appetites, and instead feed on plants and fruit.

.]] Spellbreakers (or spell breakers) are a type of blood elven warriors trained to destroy spellcasters by disrupting and contorting magical energies to their advantage. Their headquarters are on the Isle of Quel'Danas. They appear as a human unit in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne. They are relatively rare in World of Warcraft, only making a few appearances from onward.

Spectral Tutors are wraiths located in Scholomance. This mob's abilities are Mana Burn, Silence (AoE silence), Spectral Projection. (Turns invulnerable, summons 5 Spectral Projections to attack, often heals to full, 6 sec duration) Because of Spectral Projection, these mobs must be killed as quickly as possible.

Spell power coefficient is an intrinsic property of a spell that determines how much bonus damage or healing it gets from the spell power attribute accumulated from gear, buffs, and talents. In most cases, the coefficient is fixed for a spell.

Spellshadow refers to a type of magic wielded by priests, specifically Shadow priests in Shadowform. It is a multi-school, combining the Arcane and Shadow schools. Multi-school abilities benefit from bonuses that affect any of their schools, use the lowest resistance value among their schools, ignore absorption and immunity effects that apply to only some of their schools, and can be used even when one or more of their schools have been locked with an interrupt effect.

The Spell of Conjuration is a dark spell that was cast by Ner'zhul in order to create new portals on Draenor and lead the Horde to new, unspoiled worlds to conquer. Three key artifacts were needed by Ner'zhul in order to create these portals: the Jeweled Scepter of Sargeras, the Book of Medivh, and the Eye of Dalaran. The Horde of Draenor needed these artifacts because they matched with constellations from their world known as the Staff, the Tome, and the Seer. Ner'zhul awaited a special celestial event involving all three constellations alongside Draenor's moon to cast his spell. The event actually did give Ner'zhul the power to open portals to other worlds. During the process of the spell'

Spellreaper was an Azerite trait for death knights. It was removed from the database around the time the Battle for Azeroth beta ended. Like with Reap Magic and Consume Magic, this trait was ultimately given to demon hunters under a new name: Burning Soul. One of Spellreaper's spell ID's was even reused for Burning Soul.

Spellfrost is a school of magic wielded by evokers. It is a multi-school, combining the Arcane and Frost schools. Multi-school abilities benefit from bonuses that affect any of their schools, use the lowest resistance value among their schools, ignore absorption and immunity effects that apply to only some of their schools, and can be used even when one or more of their schools have been locked with an interrupt effect.

Spirit was a primary stat that regenerated health and mana. It was one of the most important stats for healers, allowing them to continue healing for prolonged periods, with lack of sufficient spirit often causing under-geared healers to run out of mana prematurely. Spirit was of no practical use to non-healing specs, since they regenerated mana by other means.
Spineshatter is a main handed mace with strength, stamina, and increased defense.

.]] Spirit Guides are factional Spirit Healers in battlegrounds and PvP zones who resurrect players who have fallen in battle. Spirit Guides can only be seen by players of the appropriate faction. Unlike normal Spirit Healers, Spirit Guides resurrect players with full health and mana and no penalty every 30 seconds. In addition, they resurrect pets or minions of the fallen player (if they had one when they died). Resurrected players are also granted the 'Preparation' buff, reducing the power cost of spells and abilities to zero for a few seconds. In battlegrounds where graveyards can be captured, capturing a graveyard will cause that graveyard's Spirit Guide to despawn, and a Spirit Guide ap

The spirit lodge trains shaman and witch doctors. The spirit lodge is a place of quiet contemplation where shamans and troll witch doctors meditate and refine their mastery of arcane magic. Having abandoned their practice of necromancy, magic users within the horde have found different ways to combat their enemies. Witch doctors manipulate chemicals within the body and in the environment, while shamans command the forces of nature. Thunder Bluff contains many spirit lodges. The main building of the Spirit Rise is modeled off of it.

Spinning Crane Kick, commonly abbreviated "SCK", is a monk ability. While channelled it deals physical damage every 0.5 seconds for 1.5 seconds (without any haste). This is the main area of effect attack for monk, meaning that this is the main ability that is used when facing against multiple enemies.

Spindlegear's Survey Craft is a flying machine belonging to Nibb Spindlegear and used by the Alliance adventurer during Survey the Destruction to fly from Honor's Stand to Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens.

.]] icon.]] A spirit champion is a mighty warrior who embraces the spirits, to assist him in his battles. He strengthens his spiritual connection until he can feel the spirits flowing within his body and thoughts, strengthening his arms and quickening his mind. Whispered fragments impart insight into battle as ancestors speak of ways to overcome all foes. The spirit champion ceases to fight for his own reasons; he battles to honor the spirits and to further their wishes. Often these wishes coincide with his own, but occasionally the spirit champion embarks on a path for reasons that are unclear to him. He does so faithfully, trusting in the spirits to point him in the right direction. The sp

.]] Spirits of Vengeance are created by the Avatar of Vengeance when it casts "Spirit of Vengeance". Spirits of Vengeance are invulnerable and will disappear after 50 seconds or when the Avatar of Vengeance is destroyed. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, spirits of vengeance appeared on the bridge leading to the traitor Cordana Felsong in the Vault of the Wardens. During the Fourth War, the spirits of Vengeance summoned during the Battle for Darkshore took the appearance of the burned Darnassus civilians instead of looking like dark wardens.

.]] Spirit wolves (aka feral spirits, ghost wolves or spectral wolves) are incorporeal creatures summoned by shaman. Spirit wolves are transparent and misty, but every bit as dangerous as the corporeal kind. These manifestations are stronger when summoned with the willing aid of the Spirit of Life. Thrall and Akama are known to summon spirit wolves. The shaman ability, Feral Spirit summons two spirit wolves. When Thrall went to Garadar to connect more deeply with the elements, he and Aggra had the forms of spirit wolves during his vision quest. Shaman can take the form of a spirit wolf with their ability Ghost Wolf.

The Spirit of Issliruk is a representation of Issliruk summoned by Elder Muahit on the Njord's Breath Bay island in the Borean Tundra after completion of Spirits Watch Over Us. The Spirit flies around the monument before flying off the south and despawning. Even though he is an ally of the tuskarr, the Spirit is hostile to players and can be killed.

Spiritfury Reagents is a reagent shop in the Valley of Strength, Orgrimmar. It is maintained by Horthus, who sells various reagents. During the Cataclysm, the building was destroyed. Horthus was since set up a small stand near the back of Grommash Hold.

Spitescale Cove is the northernmost island of the Echo Isles. The naga used this isle to build a staging ground from which to attack and destroy the Darkspear tribe. They are led by the sea witch Zar'jira. There is a cave there.

__NOTOC__ The Spirit of Anvilrage is one of the Dark Iron Thanes found in The Athenaeum in Blackwing Descent. In life, he was one of the most powerful generals in the Blackrock Depths. While he no longer lives to command the Dark Iron army, his insignia—a flaming anvil—is visible on tabards and shields beneath Blackrock Mountain to this day, and many soldiers still bear the name Anvilrage.
__NOTOC__ Spirit of Grol is the spirit of the ogre Grol the Destroyer. He is awakened when his head on a pike is touched aboard one of the wrecks off shore of Shattershore in the Blasted Lands.
Spirit of the Redeemer is a Holy priest PvP talent. It converts the passive ability Spirit of Redemption into the active ability Spirit of Redemption (Spirit of the Redeemer).
Spiritwalker Graysky is a Highmountain tauren located at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.

Spiritwind Summit is the peak of the mountain that Stonedark Grotto is located inside. The only way up is to follow a treacherous path above Stonedark Grotto, starting in the Bloodhunt Highland, and traverse most of the mountain's exposed spine to reach the peak. The peak is a tauren burial site. There is a Small Treasure Chest with the Prayers to the Earthmother inside.
Spiritwalker Isahi is a tauren that briefly appeared at the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar and later in Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Splintertree Post is a Horde outpost in Ashenvale, lying just north-west of Felfire Hill. Like most Horde outposts, Splintertree is mainly populated by orcs and tauren, all whom are primarily scouts and guards. There are several quest givers, a heavy armor vendor for repairs, an inn, mailbox, stable master, and a flight path maintained by wind rider flight master Vhulgra.

Spoops is an orc quest giver located in the Ruins of Lordaeron in the Undercity. She is only available during the annual Hallow's End event. Spoops was formerly residing in Orgrimmar, but has traveled with Orphan Matron Nanee and a few other orphans to the Ruins of Lordaeron at the Undercity, as of 2010. Spoops can be found in the main courtyard with the other orphans near the entrance.
Spore Cloud is one of the pet abilities that only sporebats can use. ;Sporebat abilities
__NOTOC__ Sprig Hashhoof is a Highmountain tauren herbalism trainer located at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Spooner Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

Splintered Spark of Shadowflame is a one-time quest reward from Power Unified. Permanent sources are the Scentsational Niffen Treasures container from the weekly A Worthy Ally: Loamm Niffen quest and Malicia's Hoard from Malicia's challenge weekly quests. Combine two to create a Spark of Shadowflame, the Dragonflight Season 2 spark item.

__NOTOC__ Sprite Darters are faerie dragons found in Feralas. For unknown reasons, the Grimtotem tauren have captured a large number of these rare creatures. Kindal Moonweaver sends adventurers on a quest to free the darters, which could eventually lead to them obtaining a Sprite Darter Egg. In addition, Witch Doctor Uzer'i seems to have an interest in the spiritual powers of these creatures. They were called upon by the Alliance, specifically Handler Jesana, to aid them in battle after the Cataclysm, and targeted and slain by the Horde.

__NOTOC__ Spymistress Mehlisah Highcrown is a human located in the Terrace of Light of the neutral Shattrath City. She is the representative of the Lower City who tries to persuade A'dal for help in the battle against the Shadow Council. Refugees each day come to her and express their concerns and seek help for their woes caused by the Shadow Council.

Sseratus, the Drakkari loa of serpents and snakes, can be found at the Altar of Sseratus in Zul'Drak. The physical manifestation of the loa is dead. When the Scourge began their invasion of Zul'Drak, the Drakkari decided to sacrifice their animal gods in order to obtain their considerable power in the fight against the Lich King. As the high prophet of Sseratus, Slad'ran took no pleasure in killing his god, but he did it all the same with the mindset that it might help them save their home, transforming himself into something half-serpent when the sacrifice transferred the immense power of Sseratus to him. The ice troll then swore vengeance on the Scourge for what they'd “made” him do to the

Stable Keeper is a collection achievement earned for learning how to summon 10 ridable mounts on a single character. The mounts can be standard, swift, flying or swift flying. You need not use any of the mounts for these achievements. Using an enchantment such as the one from Fresh Holly to change your mount will not count towards this achievement.

Springtail Crag is the main Springtail virmen nest on a ridge high above Cattail Lake's northern bank in north-central Valley of the Four Winds. The Springtail Warren-Mother is found in the far eastern hole of the three. The crag is only accessible by flying mount. Further north is the mountain range separating the valley from the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

The Sra'vess Rootchamber is underneath the Sra'vess island in Townlong Steppes. Home to the Sra'thik Hivelord, the rootchamber can be accessed from its mouth immediately south of the Sra'thik Swarmdock on the northeastern side of the island.

Sputtering Fleshrenders are shredders that arrive at Ashwood Depot in Darkshore once Tyrande Whisperwind kills almost everyone there during In Darkest Night. Once they surround her and the Alliance adventurer, Malfurion Stormrage arrives and uses his power to pull the fleshrenders beneath the earth with roots, destroying them.

's camp.]] The Stagalbog is a region of the Swamp of Sorrows which lies south of the Pool of Tears and borders the southern mountain range. It is dense marshland, with the small camp of Baba Bogbrew being the only sign of civilization. Before the Cataclysm, wind serpents hadn't been seen in the stagalbog in ages. They emerged from the nearby Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Stagalbog Cave sits at the edge of the mountains, a short distance west of Baba Bogbrew's camp.
Stamp Thunderhorn is a tauren food vendor located in the Darkmoon Faire camp, which is only available during the monthly Darkmoon Faire event.
Stampeding Shout was the Symbiosis ability granted to Arms and Fury warriors when they were the target of a Druid's Symbiosis spell. This was a modified version of the Druid ability Stampeding Roar.
__NOTOC__ Starving Mountain Lions are mountain lions found in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Stars' Rest Sentinels are night elf guards for Stars' Rest in the Dragonblight.

Stars' Rest is a small Alliance camp located south of Icemist Village in the Dragonblight. The camp is a night elf camp built within the ruins. Frost nymphs have appeared from the nearby forest to help the night elves. There is a moonwell here as well.

Stardust Spire is an Alliance outpost located in southern Ashenvale, north of Talondeep Pass in the Stonetalon Mountains. It contains survivors of the Horde takeover of Silverwind Refuge, led by Huntress Jalin, who are using the outpost as a base from which to launch attacks against the Horde. The residents of the outpost are primarily night elf Sentinels and members of a gnome explosives squad sent from Tinker Town. The flight master has connections to Astranaar, Thal'darah Overlook, Windshear Hold, and Nijel's Point. The spire consists of a shored up sentry tower, and the watchtower sits atop the remains of a bigger structure. During the War of the Thorns, the retreat was attacked by the H

The Star's Bazaar is found on the lower-left level of the Shrine of Seven Stars. Most trade supplies vendors (with the exception of Engineering and First Aid) can be found here. Outside is the Summer Terrace, the Emperor's Step can be accessed to the center of the shrine (to the right), and the Chamber of Reflection is upstairs.
Star Augur Etraeus is a boss in the Nighthold raid. He is also encountered in the Court of Stars dungeon.
__NOTOC__ Star Moss is a crafting reagent that herbalists gather from herb nodes of the same name. Scribes and alchemists use star moss as part of their professions.
Starfish or sea stars are invertebrates that have the shape of a star and varied colors. All of them are liftable items.
Staxie Yizzletorch is a gnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. She is sitting with Jorrix Powerspark. Next to her are Surprise Flowers.
Star Powder is left behind when infusing the Focused Star Point into the Heart Forge.
Star Lantern is sold by Jefan the Crafter in Moonglade for in stacks of 5.

Star Captain Barabos is a draenei rogue trainer found in Trader's Tier in the Exodar. Next to him are three Star Sailors. According to the Exodar Peacekeepers, he has recently returned from his journey.
Star Sailors are draenei rogues found next to Star Captain Barabos in Trader's Tier in the Exodar.

.]] Steamwheedle Port was a port village on the eastern coast of the Tanaris desert, in the South Seas. Belonging to the goblins' neutral Steamwheedle Cartel, it was connected by a road to its mother city of Gadgetzan to the west, and also had a dock for ships to and from Kezan. As the Cataclysm was about to start, the port reported tidal waves, was caught in fire, and was subsequently flooded and destroyed, turning it into mostly underwater ruins. Many of its residents have gone missing, were killed by the destructive forces, or went to live in Gadgetzan for a modest relocation fee. Steamwheedle Port was home to Yeh'kinya, who started the Hakkar the Soulflayer storyline with the quest Scree

__NOTOC__ Stephanos is a draenei hippogryph flight master located at the Seat of the Naaru at the bottom of the East ramp leading down into draenei capital of the Exodar. When Vindicator Maraad returned home from Northrend after the Shattering, Stephanos took his gryphon and told him about the human refugees on the isle. During the Battle for the Exodar, he was inside Velen's protective shield.

The Steam Pools is an area in southern Feralas, high in the mountains bordering Silithus, with a large lake at its base and smaller steaming hot pools found further up along the mountain side. It houses a holiday resort for the rich, run by Gadgetzan.

Gnomish inventors have always excelled at making up for physical shortcomings through technology. While the more fringe elements of gnomish technological community advocate the use of permanent steam powered prosthetics, more civilized and sane gnomes have opted for a solution that requires less surgery. Steam gauntlets are one of the many innovations that gnomes have invented to help them open jars, mine and crush things. Two pneumatically enhanced, steam-powered gauntlets attach to a bulky portable steam engine. This engine straps to the back of the wearer. The gauntlets themselves are more like gigantic armored mitts, and are usually adjustable to fit the hands of races of different sizes
Steel Gate Flying Machine is a flying machine located in Howling Fjord.
Stillwhisper Pond is a pond, just south of Silvermoon City located in Eversong Woods. It is the location of Instructor Antheol and his apprentices.
Steven Thomas is a fan of Level 80 Elite Tauren Chieftain and friend of Michael Schweitzer whom he once met in Shattrath. He can always be found at Silvermoon City watching the band.
Steven Nelson is a human flight master for Shipwreck Cove in Highmountain.

Stoki Wonderwand is a goblin located in Pathfinder's Den in Orgrimmar. During Varok Saurfang's rebellion, the entrances to Orgrimmar became surrounded by his allies, and the city was locked down on Sylvanas Windrunner's orders, causing Pathfinder's Den to be closed down as well. Stoki thus moved to the Valley of Strength where several adventurers demanded to enter the room, but the goblin didn't allow them and directed them to the Warchief instead. After Sylvanas left Orgrimmar, the portal room was opened, but Stoki remained distrustful of the former banshee loyalists, promptly refusing them to use her portals. With Orgrimmar without Warchief, the den was patrolled by First Arcanist Thalyssr

Stonard is the lone Horde outpost located in the Swamp of Sorrows. Regular patrols are sent out, and a number of small orcish encampments have been established nearby to further strengthen the Horde's control over the region. It is one of the few orcish communities to still have a great hall in its midst and is protected by two burrows. Several trainers and vendors can be found at the post. Mages with sufficient skill can learn to teleport or open a portal to here. Previously, Stonard was notable for being the location of the horde master alchemist and the only Horde shaman trainer in the Eastern Kingdoms.

Stone of the Tides is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest The Curse of the Tides. This is a powerful magical artifact that was once used by the mighty Gurubashi Empire. It allows the user to control all sorts of water and to summon water elementals. However, it also places a curse on the user which causes them to slowly fade out of existence.

The blizzard that once made the high crags of Stone Cold Mountain inaccessible has finally subsided. Rumor has it that the first expeditionary force sent to explore the area returned battered and broken. Time, it seems, has only made the mountain deadlier.[http://www.battle.net/war3/maps/war3xbonusmaps4.shtml]

Stone Guard Stok'ton is an orc quest giver located within Hellfire Ramparts and the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Peninsula. Within the Shattered Halls he is stealthed, being the last survivor of the Thrallmar expedition to the dungeon besides Caza'rez, who is heavily injured. He originally appeared in Thrallmar.

The Stone of Light was one of three artifacts created by Belo'vir Salonar, a renowned mage, during the Troll Wars, along with the Stone of Flame and the Stone of Spark. Belo'vir imbued it with the power of the Sunwell. Eventually, the traitor Dar'Khan Drathir, raised into undeath once again, stole the stones and delivered them to the Scourge. Players are tasked with recovering them, and a weapon of their choice is imbued with their power.

The Stone of Flame (also called the Stone of Fire) was one of three artifacts created by Belo'vir Salonar, a renowned mage, during the Troll Wars, along with the Stone of Light and the Stone of Spark. Belo'vir imbued it with the power of the Sunwell. Eventually, the traitor Dar'Khan Drathir, raised into undeath once again, stole the stones and delivered them to the Scourge. Players are tasked with recovering them, and a weapon of their choice is imbued with their power.

A stone watcher is a type of stone keeper. It resembles a massive humanoid statue and has a nondescript, featureless face, and is emotionless. It raises its arms to strike with stony fists. A stone watcher is 15 feet tall and weighs 6,000 pounds. The stone that makes up the watcher's body is unnatural, and no stone like it exists on Azeroth except in the construction of these constructs and the related stone keepers. This creation is incredibly swift; it relies on time magic to move with a devastating purpose. Much like the enigmatic black iron golems, there is a similarity in the apparent design of these constructs. Most stone watchers lurk over ancient ruins, guarding entrances to long-los

Stolen Parts are gnomish copters carrying crates of Spare Parts. They are located in and around Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island. Once the copters have been destroyed, the crates can be looted by everyone in the vicinity.

The Stone Legion Generals are a boss located in Castle Nathria. They are General Kaal, who we previously encounter various times during the Revendreth storyline and Venthyr Campaign as well as in the Sanguine Depths, and General Grashaal who we encounter first in The Master Awaits. This is the penultimate encounter of the raid before the final battle with Sire Denathrius. It is a 3 phase fight with 2 transitions which harshly tests the raid's ability to position dangerous abilities properly, as well as managing the dangerous Bleed debuffs that Kaal can hit players with.

The Stonefist clan, or Clan Stonefist, is a small clan of Ironforge dwarves located in Ironforge City. Dashel Stonefist resides in Old Town in Stormwind City. The only other known Stonefist was the late Bargrin Stonefist. Clan Stonefist suspected foul play when Bargrin died and accused Dernim Brasshelm, a clan rival. He was later found to be innocent.

__NOTOC__ The Stonefire Tavern is an inn located in the Commons district of the city of Ironforge, just north of the main gates. The tavern is owned by Innkeeper Firebrew and his daughter Gwenna Firebrew, and acts as one of the main taverns of the city.

The Stonetalon centaur were a group of centaur that made their home within the Stonetalon Mountains. Their Khan had a Glyph of Purification within his possession that Thrall would need to cure a befouled fountain during the Third War. As such, the centaur came under attack by the Horde which not only claimed the glyph (allowing the Horde to use the fountain to heal its warriors), but seemingly also destroyed the group.

Stonetalon Mountains is a neutral level 25-30 zone in central Kalimdor. Both Alliance and Horde are led here from Ashenvale, where some of the starting quests for this line take place. The progress of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Stonetalon Mountains Quests. After this zone is complete, or reaching level 30, Southern Barrens and Desolace are possible questing areas
Stonehand Mining is a shop located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. It is the place players go in the city to learn the mining profession.
Stonehoof Watch is a Highmountain tauren watch tower overlooking the Snowblind Cliffs leading into Stormheim from Highmountain. It is under attack by vrykul of the Tideskorn clan.
Stonedark Drogbar are drogbar located in Highmountain. Some of them are dead. They also briefly appear in the Halls of Valor.
Stonedark Geomancer is a drogbar located in the Thunder Totem in Highmountain during Legion Assaults. Despite the best efforts of the adventurers and Mayla Highmountain, he is killed by a demon.
Stones Can't Fly! is an exploration achievement earned by getting 2000 Flightstones. This is one of the criteria of the Que Zara(lek), Zara(lek) meta-achievement for Zaralek Cavern.
Stones Can Try To Fly! is an exploration achievement earned by getting 5000 Flightstones.
Stones Can Fly! is an exploration achievement earned by getting 20,000 Flightstones.
.]] Stoneward Prison (or Gilneas City Prison) is a fortified prison complex located in the Military District of Gilneas City.

The Stormbrew is a powerful brew invented by the vrykul Melba which empowers those who drink it. The monks of the Broken Temple set out to recreate the brew in order to use it as a weapon against the Burning Legion, after defending the Peak of Serenity and the Temple of the Jade Serpent.

The Storm's Wake is a faction operating in Stormsong Valley in Kul Tiras, and mainly based from the town of Brennadam. It is composed of militiamen, farmers, tidesages and other inhabitants of Stormsong Valley. When Lord Stormsong fell to corruption at the hands of Queen Azshara, the Storm's Wake fought to protect the people and rose against Stormsong. Led by Captain Ara, an army of them almost rebuked the Horde expedition of Warfang Hold, using a strange object to summon giant sea tentacles and destroy their fleet. The battle would have ended in their victory, but The Banshee's Wail arrived just in time to destroy the humans. The Storm's Wake later assisted to the ceremony when Jaina Proudm

The Stormrage Barrow Dens are the sacred barrow dens of the Moonglade where many of the nightelven druids slumber in the Emerald Dream. The great druid Malfurion Stormrage, for whom the barrow dens are named, used to slumber deep within the dens. Clintar Dreamwalker now sleeps here. Directly north of the barrow dens are Minions of Omen, high level wolf-like creatures. They only come out at night during the Lunar Festival. A part of the Moonkin Festival also occurs here.

Stormpike Emissaries are dwarf Alterac Valley recruiters located at various spots throughout the largest Alliance cities - Stormwind City, Exodar, Darnassus, and Ironforge, as well as the neutral Shattrath City during the monthly Call to Arms: Alterac Valley.
Stormpike Mountaineers are dwarf and gnome mountaineers of the Stormpike Guard. They can be found in the Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh.

Stormshield Druids are night elves found at Stormshield Stronghold in Ashran, assisting Anenga in the empowerment of the Lifeless Protector. With enough power, they will transform it into the Draenor ancient Fangraal, who will do battle for the Alliance.

Strahnbrad is a ghost town located east of Alterac and west of Chillwind Point. The town is situated in a strategic position on the northeastern foothills of the Alterac Mountains, close to the border with the Western Plaguelands. It has an abandoned town hall and blacksmith. There is a Horde flightmaster, Phillip Harding, located nearby. Gol'dir, formerly a prisoner here, stands next to him. Once a part of the Kingdom of Alterac prior to the First War, the town integrated the Kingdom of Lordaeron after the Second War, before falling under the Syndicate control following the Scourging of Lordaeron. During the Fourth War, the Forsaken took control of the village to attack the forces of the Al

The Kingdom of Stormwind (also called the Kingdom of Azeroth) is a human kingdom controlling much of the southern continent of Azeroth, from Elwynn Forest and Westfall to Duskwood and the Redridge Mountains, and a member state of the Grand Alliance. Originally settled by descendants of the Arathi, Stormwind flourished until the First War when it was conquered and laid waste by the Orcish Horde. The survivors of that conflict, led by Anduin Lothar, sought refuge in Lordaeron, but were able to reclaim their homeland at the end of the Second War with the aid of the Alliance of Lordaeron. Since the fall of the kingdom of Lordaeron during the Third War, the kingdom of Stormwind has become the str

Strand of the Ancients Emissaries were Strand of the Ancients recruiters located at various spots throughout the largest Alliance cities - Stormwind City, Exodar, Darnassus, and Ironforge, as well as the neutral cities of Dalaran and Shattrath City during the monthly Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients.

The Stormwind City Cemetery (or Stormwind Cemetary) is a large graveyard located to the north of Cathedral Square, nestled on the edge of Stormwind Lake, within Stormwind City. It contains a large number of graves and also a tomb very similar to Uther's. Among those buried here is Queen Tiffin Ellerian Wrynn, wife of King Varian.
Stormwind City Mage were human mages located in Stormwind City.

Stormwind Sea Wolves are elite members of the Stormwind military found at Shattered Beachhead of Shattershore in the Blasted Lands. They appear to be elite marines in the Alliance navy and can be found guarding the command tent in the field.
The Strand of the Stars drops from Advisor Melandrus in Court of Stars.
The Stormwind Harbor Guards is a military subgroup of the Stormwind City Guard, operating and patrolling the Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.
__NOTOC__ Stormwind Elite Guards were elite Stormwind City Guards during the first and second Scourge Invasion of Stormwind City.

Stormwind Revelers are humans located at the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and Moonglade during the Lunar Festival. They also appear in Stormwind and Elwynn Forest during the New Year and Midsummer Fire Festival firework events.
Stormwind City Clerks are humans located around Stormwind City. They are guiding the Darnassian Refugees and Displaced Gilnean Refugees and counting the dead from the War of the Thorns.
__NOTOC__ Strength of Will can be purchased for from: * in Duskwood * in Hillsbrad Foothills * in Stonetalon Mountains
Strength of the Violet Tower is an necklace available to both factions as a quest reward. The combination of stamina, strength, defense on this ring make it a nice one for tanks.
.]] Strength of Arms is a Warrior talent in the Arms-Tree that increases total Stamina, total Strength and Expertise of the Warrior.
Strength of Mugamba is a quest reward from Strength of Mount Mugamba (1).
Strike is a warrior ability. It is the warrior's starting ability, and is learnt automatically upon character creation.

Strength of Soul was a passive specialization ability for Discipline priests, available at level 52. It caused the priest's Heal (Classic), Greater Heal and Flash Heal to reduce the duration of any Weakened Soul debuff on the target by 2 seconds.

Stranglethorn Imported Fruit & Spirits is a fruit shop found along the eastern wall outside the Grommash Hold in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. Although her previous location was not destroyed in the Cataclysm, Shan'ti left the building in the alley leading to the Cleft of Shadow and opened a small stand outside the eastern wall of Grommash Hold.
Strength of Xuen is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Healing Winds and Power of a Thousand Cranes traits.
Strength of the Earth Aspect is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Neltharion's Fury, Rage of the Fallen, and Shatter the Bones traits.
The Strength of the Storm Totem is a totem summoned by Melgromm Highmountain at the Stair of Destiny in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Strength of Menethil is created with Classic Blacksmithing (300); taught by Ancient Plans: Strength of Menethil.

Sturdiness was a pet ability available exclusively to the goat family of hunter pets, increasing player Stamina by 10%. It was functionally identical to the bear family's Invigorating Roar, but surpassed in effectiveness by the Savage Vigor of the rylak family and the Qiraji Fortitude of the silithid family, which provide additional haste and spell power, respectively.
Sturm Oakenhorn is a Highmountain tauren blacksmithing apprentice found at the Ironhorn Enclave in Highmountain, training under the supervision of Thala Steeltotem.
The Stygian Scar was an Horde destroyer stationed off the coast of the Jade Forest. It was destroyed by Alliance forces.

Strongarm Gyrocopters are gyrocopters flying above the Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest. They are piloted by Strongarm Airmen. After the Horde took the base, some are seen destroyed on the ground. One was repurposed by the Horde.

The Struggling Mothling is a moth located at the Shimmering Towers in Zaralek Cavern. Teach the moth to fly by follow the shadow below and bounce it 5 times. Having learnt to fly, it will reveal a Moth-Pilfered Pouch.

Committing suicide by using a self-damaging ability to kill your character counts as a player-caused kill and does not have the -10% durability penalty attached to it. This does not apply to dying from a hazardous environment, such as standing in fire, swimming in lava, or jumping off a cliff.

icon.]] Subversives are militant defenders of the wild who use guerilla tactics and sabotage to safeguard the land. While their methods may be morally questionable, subversives dedicate their lives to defending nature and its inhabitants. They believe that Azeroth's welfare and survival depend on the state of the wilderness and the creatures populating it. When nature is destabilized, everything in the world is thrown into anarchy — and everyone suffers. Recent history strengthens this belief, as many men and women already closely tied to nature — such as druids, hunters and scouts — bore witness to the havoc magic and warfare bring. Although subversives have existed for a long time, they ar
Sulamm was a tauren shaman of the Highmountain tribe. He was visited by Trag Highmountain after he became an undead.

Summon Imp is a warlock ability used to summon a controllable Imp to be your minion. The imp is the first demonic minion available to the warlock, and available at the beginning of the game. Of the five regular warlock pets, the Imp has the least health, but it makes up for this by being a ranged spell caster with defensive and utility abilites.
Summon is an ability, power, or spell that allows the transporting of a creature from another place (in game world, other dimension, etc.) to the caster.
Summon Succubus is a warlock ability that summons a Succubus to be the warlock's minion. It is functionally identical to the Summon Incubus ability.

Sun Rock Retreat (also spelled Sunrock Retreat) is a Horde settlement centrally-located in the Stonetalon Mountains, hidden amid the peaks south of Mirkfallon Lake. It was once the area's primary hub of activity and trade, hosting a contingent of predominantly orcish and tauren forces devoted to repairing the damage done to the mountains by the Venture Company and other malignant forces. In the wake of the Cataclysm and the establishment of other Horde settlements at Krom'gar Fortress and Cliffwalker Post, however, the village has become little more than a geographical footnote, offering few services and even fewer reasons to visit. In ages past, tauren made pilgrimages to Sun Rock Retreat t

Summoners are casters that summon living beings, things or items, magic, and weather changes. They are mostly mages and warlocks. Summons can be mental or physical. Warlock summoners often act as teachers. Shaman summoner are able to summon elementals. Summoners are also able to open portals. Conjurers and archmages can summon and control a powerful water elemental comprised of water and air vapors, and scorpions. Far seers can summon spirit wolves. Dreadlords summon infernals. Crypt fiends summon swarms of vile insects. Scourge acolytes are able to unsummon buildings. Mages can summon torrential storms or blizzards.

Summon Felguard is a Demonology warlock ability. The felguard, as it is unique to demonology, is heavily influenced by their talent tree; and is usually seen as the 'main' demon for the specialization as a result. It largely is made to be a sort of 'jack-of-all-trades' demon, as it has the ability to deal heavy damage, tank, and possesses a crowd control utility in the form of Axe Toss. Grimoire: Felguard summons an uncontrollable guardian pet version of this pet which is visually larger, and can be active at the same time as the Summon Felguard version.
The Summoned Succubus could be found at the following locations: * Undercity * Stormwind City * Orgrimmar

The Summoned Voidwalker is a mob summoned by several early warlock quests. The player must summon and defeat a voidwalker in order to earn the demon's services. It can be found in Undercity, Stormwind City, Orgrimmar, and Ghostlands.

:Were you looking for the dagger, Searing Sunblade? The Sunblade were a group of blood elves loyal to Kael'thas Sunstrider who guard the Magisters' Terrace and the Sunwell Plateau on the Isle of Quel'Danas from interlopers. They were the elite counterparts to the Dawnblade blood elves that oversaw the rest of the island and served as the front lines against the Scourge, the Shattered Sun Offensive, and even the wretched. Their armies in Sunwell Plateau were incredibly dangerous, just one protector was able to gruesomely murder half the Shattred Sun army near the entrance. The rest of the sinister Sunblade soldiers guarded the way from the plaza into the Dead Scar, where their felblood succes

__NOTOC__ Summoner Nolric is a high elf warlock trainer located in the Silver Enclave in the mage city of Dalaran. He was present in the city when it relocated above Deadwind Pass but did not offer his training services as he had to remain alert for any danger to Dalaran's visitors.
The Summer Terrace is outside the Shrine of Seven Stars. The flight master can be found on the upper level, and breadcrumbs to all of the Pandaria factions are on the lower level.
Sun Spheres appear in the Dranosh'ar Blockade for To Be Prepared (Horde). Clicking one out gives out the Holy Enchantment buff. They are from Silvermoon City.

Summon Incubus is a warlock ability that summons an Incubus to be the warlock's minion. It is functionally identical to the Summon Succubus ability. The spell is acquired by completing the quest The Binding (Incubus).

Sunstrider Isle is a small island located in northwestern Eversong Woods. After the Third War, no elf remained alive on the isle. It was through here that the red dragon Korialstrasz flew over when Prince Kael'thas destroyed the corrupted Sunwell. By the year 25, the isle was reclaimed and thriving.
Sungraze Peak is a mountain in central Ghostlands. It holds the Amani Catacombs, and has both Tranquillien and An'telas nestled in on the mountain's base.

__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Guardian Mages guard the Horde district of Dalaran, the Sunreaver's Sanctuary. They are hostile to Alliance players, and will teleport any of them away if approached. They bear the name of their leader, Archmage Aethas Sunreaver. By the time Dalaran was teleported to Deadwind Pass, the Sunreaver's Sanctuary was now empty and patrolled by Kirin Tor Guardians. Strangely, Sunreaver Guardian Mages reappeared in the Sanctuary when Dalaran was next attacked by the Burning Legion. They have been replaced by Forsaken Guards as of Dalaran's relocation to the Broken Isles.
The Sunwell Plateau is a raid instance located on the Isle of Quel'Danas north of Silvermoon City.

This handsome ring is carved of gold and has a crystal set at its center. Around the stone are the phases of the sun. High elves place great value on these new creations. This powerful ring blocks a high elf’s magic addiction and the attached penalties. The ring takes twenty-four hours to attune to a new wearer in order to provide this benefit.

The Sunveil Excursion is a blood elf encampment located to the southwest of the Blasted Lands. Set up at the time at the time of the Cataclysm, its inhabitants are members of the Reliquary, the Horde equivalent of the Explorers' Guild. Interested in the demonic artifacts once hidden in the Tainted Scar, the leader of the excursion, Rohan Sunveil, ordered the creation of the camp and led his subordinates to practice an archaeological study in the Tainted Forest, where they focused their work in the acquisition, cataloging, and preservation of any and all magical artifacts. Suppression Spires are Faithless sethrak constructs located around the Crackling Ridge in Vol'dun, where the Faithless use them to subjugate the local pterrordax. Vorrik asks Horde adventurers to empower his staff by draining power from the spires.

Suntouched Ritualists are tol'vir located in the Chamber of the Stars in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. Four of them are powering a ritual with the Chosen Ascendant as focus. Once they are defeated, he too will die.
Superior Battle Potion of Strength is created with Kul Tiran Alchemy (175); taught by Narv/Instructor Okanu and Recipe: Superior Battle Potion of Strength.

Sura Wildmane is a tauren war harness vendor located on the High Rise in Thunder Bluff. She attended the feast for the Highmountain tauren in the city. She was seen speaking with Sunn Ragetotem. She was later trapped by the Void.
Surge of Power is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Surface Trot is an exotic pet ability available exclusively to the water strider family of hunter pets. ;Water Strider abilities

Svena the Infused is a vrykul ghost. In life, she was an alchemist and wrote Runewritten Tome. When Deucus Valdera tried to read its translation, the ghost appeared in his shop, threatening to destroy Dalaran, and began casting a spell. Fortunately, Archmage Khadgar sensed her presence, so he quickly arrived and blasted her away, but not before she destroyed Deucus' alchemy table. Later, she appeared Katterin's Hideaway in Stormheim after an adventurer alchemist killed Katterin the Blistered. She threatened him to return her book.

Swailes was a member of the crew on the Bold Arva commanded by Flynn Fairwind that aided Mathias Shaw in his mission to check the costs of Zandalar for signs that the Banshee loyalists were on the continent. He is a short lad, hardly more than twenty, with a pockmarked face, and blue eyes. After the fire on the ship was put out, he delivered a message to Shaw.
Swipe is a druid ability granted by the Swipe (druid ability) talent. It is mainly a tool to keep aggro on multiple mobs.

.]] The Swarming Pillar was a large silithid-infested peak in the middle of Silithus containing one of their hives, just south of Cenarion Hold. It got its name from a massive swarm of small silithid that buzzed around the hive. Although being the largest, it was just one of the too many hives whose foundations were built beneath the sands of Silithus. The silithid hive was eventually destroyed at the end of the third invasion of the Burning Legion when Sargeras tried to destroy Azeroth through Silithus.

The Swift Green Gryphon can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Hellfire Peninsula * in Shadowmoon Valley * in Borean Tundra * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City
The Swift Purple Gryphon can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Hellfire Peninsula * in Shadowmoon Valley * in Borean Tundra * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City
The Swift Red Gryphon can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Hellfire Peninsula * in Shadowmoon Valley * in Borean Tundra * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City
The Swift Mooncloth Carpet was never made available. It would have used the same model as the Frosty Flying Carpet.

Swamplighter Hive is found at hanging from a tree at the southern end of the river next to the waterfall in Blademoon Bloom in southern . The sticky, sweet liquid inside of swamplighter hives is highly combustible. Loot the hive to acquire the Angry Beehive toy, but be warned that looting the object will aggro every wasp flying nearby!
The Sweaty Wristbands drop from the Death Metal Knight in the Blight Boar event on Darkmoon Island.

Swiftflight is an hippogryph in the Explorer's League camp on the shore line of Val'sharah and Azsuna. It has no health, and cannot be clicked. The hippogryph appears to be part of a rare event triggering Skul'vrax to spawn, the event begins when you find Elindya Featherlight to the west of the camp. After avenging Swiftflight, Elindya Featherlight despawns leaving the hippogryph's body.

Swiftwind Post is a Horde Highmountain outpost located in eastern Drustvar. Druids stationed here were seeking information concerning ancient Drust rituals. As a result, their learned about the Drust' nature magic.

Swarming mist is the death knight class ability of the Venthyr Covenant. It's available to all death knights who join the Venthyr. This ability is also temporarily available during the Revendreth portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Authority of Revendreth and lasts until you finish the Revendreth storyline.
Sweet Dreams is an anima power obtained from anima caches left behind after defeating Karthazel in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. The power grants a Orb of Deception (Shadowlands).

The Sythegore Arm was the title of the Orcish Horde's division of raiders. Blackhand was a member of the Sythegore Arm before rising to power. This is the only mention of the term. It may or may not apply to all orcish raiders. Orgrim Doomhammer disbanded all raiders within the Horde after he took power because he feared that they would betray him in an attempt to put Rend or Maim on the throne (which was untrue; it was an attempt by Gul'dan to gain the Warchief's trust after his near-brush with death). By the beginning of the Second War, wolf-riders were no longer common within the ranks of the Horde's armies. Therefore, whatever the Sythegore Arm was, it likely stopped existing.

Lady Szenastra was a naga sorceress under the command of Lady Szallah. Szenastra was in charge of the naga attack on Feathermoon Stronghold in the wake of the Cataclysm. She sent a naga siren as an emissary to offer Shandris Feathermoon the terms of their peace: Shandris was to bring them the head of "the false queen," Tyrande Whisperwind; Shandris replied by shooting the emissary in the throat. Lady Szenastra was killed by Tyrande and her husband Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage when they arrived to rescue Shandris.
__NOTOC__ Syd the Squid is rarely contained in the Greater Darkmoon Pet Supplies goodie bag awarded for defeating Christoph VonFeasel in the daily quest A New Darkmoon Challenger!
Sylvester Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

Sylvern's Roost is a small island west of the Morqut Islet off the western shore of the Forbidden Reach mainland. The island is inhabited by Amberfur Slyvern and Amberfur Alphas. The battle pet world quest Combustible Vegetation occasionally takes place here, spawning Wildfire and some Storm-Touched Skitterers.

The Tahonda Ruins used to be a tauren village that was destroyed and abandoned. The ruins now lay underwater in the southern reaches of Shimmering Deep near the path through the mountain to Tanaris. Little to no information was known about this village. The ruins were inhabited by Saltstone basilisks, which might have been the reason why it was abandoned. An attack was believed to have happened evidenced by the two sets of three parallel tears in the leather of one of the buildings. When the area was flooded due to the Cataclysm, the basilisks were killed and debris floated to the surface.
The Tabard of the Shattered Sun is a tabard. It is a mark of honor amongst the Shattered Sun Offensive faction and is only available to its most trusted allies.

Tah Winterhoof is a tauren located in the Winterhoof Totems shop on the High Rise in Thunder Bluff. He attended the feast for the Highmountain tauren in the city. He was seen sitting next to the Festive Keg. He was later trapped by the Void.
Tabo the Flyer is a pandaren flight master located at Westwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.
